title: Microsoft-provided SMS and voice MFA retires on 1 February 2027
summary: Microsoft is retiring the SMS and voice authentication methods it provides in Microsoft Entra ID and is moving users to passkeys by default. From 1 February 2027, users whose only MFA method is SMS or voice will be asked to register a passkey before they can sign in. Global Administrators and external users follow on 1 July 2027.
why: If many users still rely on text messages or phone calls, they will all hit a blocking registration prompt on the same day, and your service desk will feel it. Passkeys are also phishing-resistant, so moving early improves security.
todo: Find who still depends on SMS or voice with the usage tools linked from Microsoft's retirement guide.
Enable passkeys (FIDO2) for those users and run a registration campaign well before the date.
Plan separately for admins and external users, who have until 1 July 2027.
effective_note: 1 July 2027 for Global Administrators and external users
